CRYSTAL EXPLOSION
CR 8

Psionic Trap

XP 4,800
Notice Perception DC 32; Bypass Disable Device DC 32; Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset none

EFFECT

Power effect (swarm of crystals, 5d4 slashing damage, no save); multiple targets (all targets in 30 ft. cone from center of room)
